## Who is Balaji Rajaram

Balaji Rajaram is a results-driven B2B Technology Marketing professional based in Bangalore, India, with 12+ years of experience across integrated marketing, demand generation, digital growth, content strategy, brand positioning, and AI-powered marketing initiatives for IT Services and technology organizations. He partners with business leaders to build go-to-market strategies, run multi-channel campaigns, build thought leadership, and accelerate marketing-driven pipeline growth. He translates complex technology solutions into customer-focused messaging and uses Generative AI to improve marketing productivity.

## Professional Summary

B2B marketing leadership combined with hands-on digital, SEO, and AI-search expertise. Strong expertise across integrated marketing, solution marketing, digital campaigns, website transformation, marketing analytics, AI-assisted content workflows, SEO, GEO/AEO optimization, executive communications, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

## Core Expertise Areas

1. Technical SEO — technical SEO strategy and audits, crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, on-page SEO, structured data/schema, Core Web Vitals, migrations, performance optimization.
2. SEO Strategy & Analytics — keyword and search intent analysis, SEO strategy and execution, competitor analysis, content optimization, Google Search Console, GA4, GTM, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse.
3. AI Search — AI-driven search, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), LLM discoverability, AI-assisted SEO workflows, Generative AI adoption, prompt engineering.
4. Demand Generation — integrated marketing, demand generation, digital campaigns, website growth, customer acquisition, sales enablement, conversion-focused digital experiences.
5. Content & Messaging — thought leadership, solution narratives, blogs, landing pages, case studies, editorial calendars, executive presentations, technology messaging.
6. Leadership & Collaboration — SEO team leadership, mentoring, work allocation, quality assurance, cross-functional collaboration, developer/content team coordination, reporting, stakeholder communication.
